title: Solve an ordered pivot list
statement: For a finite variable type, recursively turn a list of variable–equation pairs into an assignment: the empty list gives the identically zero assignment, and a nonempty list applies the pivot-value update for its first pair to the assignment obtained from the remaining list.
hypotheses_covered: The variable type has decidable equality
